ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act [Cap. 222] (as amended); Anti-Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing Act No. 33 of 2016 (as amended by the Anti-Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing (Amendment) Act 2018); Financial Services Commission Act No. 32 of 2016; Financial Services Commission (Electronic Transactions) Act 2020; name and UBO registration directives issued by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) under the VFSC circular regime.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of passport (photo and signature page) for each director, shareholder, and ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public or competent government authority in the country of residence of the individual
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (Republic of Vanuatu is not a party to the Hague Apostille Convention; documents must be legalized by the Vanuatu High Commission/Embassy or the Ministry of Foreign Affairs in the document's origin country, followed by authentication at the Vanuatu Ministry of Foreign Affairs)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement dated within 3 months)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider or licensed bank in the individual's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (same path as above; alternatively notarized and officially authenticated if origin state is a non-Hague party)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter confirming the client's banking and business history and confirming source of wealth
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed bank in the individual's or entity's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization through the Vanuatu Ministry of Foreign Affairs or Vanuatu diplomatic post in the issuing country

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Professional reference letter from a lawyer, accountant, or established business associate
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Professional service provider in good standing in a recognized jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (notarization of signature plus Ministry of Foreign Affairs authentication in the origin country and subsequent legalization in Vanuatu)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Curriculum vitae or professional background summary for directors and material shareholders
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (notarized affidavit confirming the truth of contents)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation (if existing corporate body is to be a shareholder or director)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Registry of the original corporate jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization or Apostille, depending on the issuing state's treaty status; if the issuing state is an Apostille party, Apostille required, followed by VFSC acceptance review

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all directors, shareholders, beneficial owners, and officers against: (i) Vanuatu Financial Services Commission's domestic sanctions and enforcement lists; (ii) United Nations Security Council Consolidated List; (iii) OFAC Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) List; (iv) FATF black-list and gray-list monitoring; and (v) Interpol and national police financial intelligence databases. Screening is performed electronically before acceptance and refreshed on a 90-day recurring cycle or on any material change in ownership. PEPs must be identified and subject to enhanced due diligence and, where applicable, require authorization from a VFSC-licensed registered agent's compliance officer, with corroboration of source of funds and source of wealth.

statutory_specifics_notes.aml_filing_protocol: No public beneficial ownership filing; UBO information is held by the VFSC and the registered agent, accessible only to the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU), the VFSC supervisory unit, and foreign competent authorities upon mutual legal assistance treaty request.
statutory_specifics_notes.nominee_permissibility: Vanuatu law permits nominee directors and nominee shareholders; however, nominee arrangements must be disclosed to the registered agent, and the ultimate beneficial owner must be identified to the VFSC for AML/CFT purposes. Nominee services carry no automatic filing exemption.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Company Registry - International Company Name Search and Reservation Portal
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: All company names must be in Latin script (English, French, or Bislama, or a combination). Vanuatu's official languages are Bislama, English, and French; however, the company registry accepts names written in standard Latin characters only. Non-Latin scripts are not permitted in the primary registered name; transliteration into a Latin-script version is mandatory. The name must be distinguishable from existing registered names and must not be false, misleading, or suggest a connection to a government agency, a regulated financial institution, or an international organization without prior consent.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the applicant's registered agent may file a written submission with the VFSC Corporate Registry within 14 days of the rejection notice, setting out the grounds of objection and any rectifying amendments to the proposed name. The VFSC must issue a written determination within 10 business days. If the rejection is upheld, the applicant may file a formal appeal to the Minister of Finance and Economic Management within 21 days, who has discretion to grant a ministerial waiver for non-mandatory but sensitive tokens. A final judicial review is available through the Supreme Court of Vanuatu under the International Companies Act and the Judicial Review Act. Name reservations may be renewed once for an additional 30-day period upon payment of a renewal fee.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: No. A Vanuatu International Company must maintain a registered office at a physical address in Vanuatu provided by or through a licensed registered agent. The registered office cannot be a post-office box or a virtual-only address. However, operational and administrative functions may be conducted remotely, and the director and shareholder meetings may be held by telephone, video conference, or written resolution in accordance with the company's constitution. The registered agent's address will be the official service of process and statutory mailing address; no separate business activity, employees, or physical premises are required for the International Company unless the company later obtains a VFSC license.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low (estimated 5% probability for a low-risk, software-only non-licensed International Company within the first 5 years of incorporation). Unannounced physical inspections are rare for non-licensed international companies, but the VFSC retains the right to conduct compliance visits and verify the registered agent's files. If the company later obtains a financial license, the physical inspection likelihood rises to 35-50%.

additional_professional_facts.tax_exemption_confirmation: A Vanuatu International Company formed under the International Companies Act is exempt from all Vanuatu taxes, including corporate income tax, withholding tax, capital gains tax, and stamp duty on shares. No VAT or goods and services tax applies to the offshore company. There is no exchange control regime and no requirement to file annual financial statements publicly. The only recurring statutory costs are the annual VFSC renewal fee and the registered agent fee.
additional_professional_facts.aml_risk_tier_comment: The proposed scope of 'Personal Wealth Analytics and Investment Tracking Cloud' is classified as Low-Risk_Standard under Vanuatu's risk-based AML/CFT approach because it is a non-financial, non-banking software platform with no custody of client funds, no payment services, and no direct banking relationship. However, if the platform integrates payment rails such as Stripe or Apple IAP, the VFSC will treat the entity as an ancillary technology provider and will still require ongoing transaction monitoring and beneficiary identification where applicable, including the implementation of a risk-based AML policy.
additional_professional_facts.soft_tax_registry_note: Vanuatu's international financial center remains under the active surveillance of the FATF and the OECD Global Forum. Although no statutory license is required for this software activity, the VFSC will issue a 'Certificate of Non-Licensed Status' on request. The company must be prepared to demonstrate economic substance equivalent to its remote operational footprint, and must not market itself without appropriate disclaimers as having Vanuatu banking credentials.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 1992 [Cap. 222], ss. 6-14 (incorporation procedure), s. 26 (name requirements), s. 48 (registered office); VFSC (International Companies) Fee Regulations; Economic Substance Regulations 2019 (applicable notification only; non-resident IC exempt)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) — International Companies Registry, Port Vila
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Form IC-1 (Application for Registration of an International Company) submitted together with the Memorandum and Articles of Association
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; the Memorandum must declare authorized capital (standard US$50,000). No escrow or advance contribution requirement; unissued reserve shares are available for later allotment by board resolution.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED that the incorporation of the Company under the International Companies Act, [Cap. 222], be and is hereby approved. RESOLVED that the allotment of one fully paid ordinary share to the subscriber named in the Memorandum of Association be accepted and recorded in the Register of Members, and that the balance of authorized capital remain unissued. RESOLVED that the registered office be fixed at the office of the licensed registered agent, VFSC-agent, Port Vila, Vanuatu. RESOLVED that [Director] be appointed sole director and [Secretary] be appointed corporate secretary. RESOLVED that the registered agent be retained to comply with statutory filing obligations.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Name Availability Search and Reservation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC International Companies Registry, Port Vila
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit via a licensed registered agent a name-search request in Form IC-0 with two ranked name choices. Ensure the proposed name ends with 'Limited', 'Corporation', 'Incorporated', 'Ltd', 'Corp.' or 'Inc.' and does not contain restricted words (Bank, Trust, Insurance, Finance) unless a sector licence is separately held.
required_dossiers: Draft Memorandum of Association showing the proposed company name
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is reserved by an existing entity or is otherwise unregistrable, file a substitute name request on a fresh Form IC-0; the reservation fee is credited once toward the amended application.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Execution of Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Vanuatu Registered Agent and overseas notary public
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent prepares the Memorandum and Articles of Association conforming to ss. 8-9 of the International Companies Act [Cap. 222]. The subscriber executes the document before a notary public in their jurisdiction; the notarial signature page is apostilled or consular-certified for VFSC acceptance. Authorized capital is fixed at US$50,000 with one subscriber share.
required_dossiers: Memorandum and Articles of Association (original, notarized)
Notarized consent of proposed first director
Notarized subscriber declaration confirming non-resident status
Beneficial owner due diligence package (passport, proof of address, source of funds)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If VFSC queries execution formalities, the agent obtains a supplementary notarized execution signature page or a corrected Form IC-1 within five business days without repayment of the registration fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of Form IC-1 to VFSC
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC International Companies Registry (e-portal submission through licensed registered agent)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent files Form IC-1 together with the executed Memorandum and Articles of Association, director's consent, registered agent acceptance, and remits the US$300 government registration fee from client funds.
required_dossiers: Form IC-1 (signed by the registered agent)
Memorandum and Articles of Association (two copies)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: On a VFSC requisition, the agent cures the stated deficiency (e.g., missing consent, non-complying name, incomplete statutory declaration) and re-files within 14 days; if registration is rejected, the fee is applied to a fresh filing under a newly reserved name.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Following verification against ss. 6-10 of the International Companies Act [Cap. 222], the VFSC registers the company, assigns its International Company number, and issues the Certificate of Incorporation. Legal personality commences on the certificate date.
required_dossiers: Approved Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate is not issued within the service standard, the agent issues a written follow-up to VFSC; any typographic error in the company name is corrected through the standard Certificate of Correction procedure.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Statutory Records and Registered Office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The company opens statutory records at the registered office in Port Vila under s. 48 of the International Companies Act [Cap. 222]: Register of Members, Register of Directors, Register of Charges, and minute book. The first board resolution is recorded in the minutes.
required_dossiers: Minutes of the First Board Meeting
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Failure to maintain statutory records is an offence under s. 76 of the Act; immediate remediation consists of preparing the missing register and passing a board ratification resolution restating entries as at the date of incorporation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: VFSC Annual License Renewal and Tax Status Notification
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The annual license fee is paid on each incorporation anniversary through the registered agent. For a wholly foreign-owned International Company that conducts no local business, a statutory declaration of non-local business is filed and no Vanuatu income tax return is required; the registered agent confirms nil economic substance notification obligations where the company is not tax-resident in Vanuatu.
required_dossiers: Registered Agent confirmation of tax-exempt status
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Late payment attracts a penalty of VT 25,000 plus a late fee; if the license has lapsed, a Restoration Application (Form IC-8) with reinstatement fee is filed within 90 days to restore good standing and re-obtain the certificate.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) — Registration and Licensing Division
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: International Company Certificate of Incorporation (no separate industrial or sectorial operating permit required for a purely digital FinTech software platform under ISIC 6201)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Vanuatu Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — no physical establishment, manufacturing plant, or EIA-relevant activity threshold triggered by a cloud-hosted SaaS platform under the Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) Administration Regulation 2011
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable. Software-only operations generate no local wastewater discharge, volatile organic compound emissions, or hazardous waste streams. If a physical Port Vila office is later opened, general waste handling must comply with the Waste Management and Pollution Control Act [Cap. 283], and office e-waste must be surrendered to a licensed recycler.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not applicable to an offshore International Company maintaining no physical premises; a virtual office at the registered agent's address in Port Vila requires no fire or structural clearance. Should the company later lease real premises in Vanuatu, it must obtain (i) a fire safety certificate from the Vanuatu Fire Services under the Fire Service Act, (ii) structural floor-load clearance from the Public Works Department, and (iii) workplace registration with the Vanuatu Department of Labour, Occupational Safety and Health Unit.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Department of Customs and Inland Revenue (DCIR), Government of Vanuatu; digital portal at https://dcir.gov.vu
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign entity must first register as an International Company with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC). The VFSC registration number serves as the foundation identifier. Thereafter, apply for a tax identification number (TIN) and VAT ID through the DCIR VATeam online registration system by submitting the certificate of incorporation, registered office address, director/shareholder details, and proof of VFSC registration. A local tax representative may be required for non-resident registrants. Because an International Company is exempt from income tax, the TIN is primarily used for VAT, customs, and statutory reporting obligations under Vanuatu's value-added tax regime.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Vanuatu does not operate a check-the-box pass-through regime. International Companies may elect for a tax exemption certificate under section 15 of the International Companies Act. No hybrid mismatch election is available, as Vanuatu has no income tax treaty network, no CFC attribution rules, and no corporate income tax for International Companies.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VAT 10,000,000 (VUV) per calendar year for local taxable supplies. Non-resident digital service suppliers are registrable when their supplies to private consumers in Vanuatu exceed this turnover threshold.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time e-invoicing clearance or digital stamping mandate is currently in operation. Registered businesses must maintain VAT-compliant tax invoices and file periodic VAT returns through the DCIR VATeam portal. Customs import and export declarations are processed via ASYCUDA World. Full API-based fiscal clearance and continuous transaction control are not yet statutory requirements.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating applies to the export of goods where ownership passes to a non-resident and the goods are physically exported within 28 days. Zero-rating also applies to the supply of services to a non-resident where the services are consumed wholly outside Vanuatu, including software-as-a-service, cloud-based financial portfolio tracking, data analytics, and other offshore digital services. The supplier must be registered for VAT, retain documentary evidence of the export nature, and declare the supply as zero-rated on the VAT return.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (CUS) approved by the Vanuatu Customs Authority.
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing physical export.
Inward Remittance Certificate proving receipt of foreign exchange.
Signed contract, purchase order, or subscription agreement identifying the non-resident recipient.
Service Completion Certificate or performance evidence for offshore services.
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Zero-rating claims are subject to DCIR audit. False or unsupported claims require repayment of VAT previously zero-rated, plus interest from the date the VAT was first claimed. Penalties include an additional tax of up to 50% of the unpaid amount, a fixed penalty of VT 500,000 for fraudulent evasion, and criminal prosecution for knowing misstatement. International Companies may also be stripped of their tax-exempt status and face deregistration by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Vanuatu Vatu (VUV) is freely convertible across both current and capital accounts. No exchange control legislation or RBV approval is required for inward or outward remittances, dividend distributions, loan repayments, or capital repatriation. Profit remittance by an International Company is unrestricted subject to commercially reasonable documentation (audited financial statements, tax registration confirmation, and shareholder resolution). The absence of capital account controls makes Vanuatu a low-friction jurisdiction for treasury flows.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory export proceeds surrender rules exist. There is no mandatory conversion ratio and no timeline requiring export or service revenue to be repatriated or converted into VUV, enabling natural-currency treasury holding.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Vanuatu National Provident Fund Bank (historically, now NBV)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low direct viability. Non-bank foreign digital EMIs (e.g., global fintech platforms) that are not licensed by the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu may not provide segregated client escrow accounts in VUV and are constrained by Vanuatu's Banking Act and Financial Institutions Act. The International Company should rely on Tier-1 commercial banks or RBV-licensed banks for clearing and settlement; foreign EMIs may only be used for pure card-acquiring or SaaS subscription settlement subject to VFSC licensing assessment, and any such EMI wallet must be positioned as a downstream collection channel, not as the primary treasury account.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Remote opening is permitted but substantially more scrutinized. Directors are not statutorily required to appear physically if the bank receives certified copies of passports, proof of address, corporate registration, and beneficial ownership declarations via legalized or notarized channel. In practice, domestic banks usually require at least one prospective signatory or corporate director to attend a video interview that is recorded, and final board approval may require an in-person onboarding visit to the bank's Port Vila branch for high-risk or non-resident-only entities. A full virtual account opening without any physical touchpoint is only available under enhanced due diligence waivers for public-company-backed shareholders.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: International Company with 100% non-resident beneficial owners and no local nexus
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certificate of Incorporation; certificate of good standing from Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC); register of members and ultimate beneficial owner declaration; notarized passport copies of all directors and shareholders; lease or virtual office agreement in Vanuatu; audited or management financials showing real software subscription activity; and a clear written treasury statement of expected incoming/outgoing flows with source-of-wealth evidence for the funding remitter.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Software app with recurring subscription payment rails (Stripe, Apple IAP) creating high-frequency cross-border card settlements
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Detailed AML/CTF risk assessment certifying the entity as Low_Risk_Standard; platform agreement with Stripe/Apple; processing reports showing customer names in non-sanctioned countries; treatment of chargebacks and refund flows; confirmation of no P2P or money-laundering red-flag patterns; and legal opinion confirming the business model is a technology service rather than an unlicensed financial service.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inbound capital injection from non-banking financial institution or offshore holding company
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed board resolution; subscription agreement; shareholder loan agreement with explicit term, interest rate, and repayment schedule; source-of-funds evidence (audited financial statements, tax returns, bank transaction summary of the lending entity); certificate of incorporation of the lending entity; and a written legal attestation of the lending entity's compliance with its home jurisdiction's economic substance or tax transparency rules.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Perceived mismatch between minimal local substance and high treasury turnover
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Substance credential file: employment contract of the local resident director; annual return filed with VFSC; physical office lease; minutes of board meetings held in Vanuatu; professional service agreements with Vanuatu law or accounting firms; and a tax profile statement demonstrating Vanuatu tax-exempt status and absence of any harmful intellectual property regime.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: For equity injections, use SWIFT MT103 or MT202 with purpose code 'CAP_INJ' (worded 'Capital injection – share subscription') or the applicable ISO 20022 purpose code ‘CAPB – Capital Payments’. The remittance narrative must reference the IC's certificate number and the bank account name. For shareholder loans, use purpose code 'ENRG' or 'LOAN' and attach the executed shareholder loan agreement to the bank instruction. RBV does not require advance approval, but banks will verify the credit narrative and underlying corporate documents; funds must be held in an account styled under the legal entity exactly as registered under the International Companies Act.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: SaaS licensing and software subscription payments settle via SWIFT MT103 covers for recurring subscription or professional service disbursements. For significant software licensing intellectual-property disbursements, a Commercial Letter of Credit (MT700) or a documentary collection (MT400) may be used where the counterparty requires bank-assured payment. Intercompany treasury sweeps should use MT202 and be pre-agreed with the bank to ensure regulatory reporting as a balance-sheet movement, not a trade payment. Payment rails to cloud providers (AWS, Azure, Stripe, Apple) are executed via ordinary business account outgoing wire, not blocked by RBV.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Vanuatu VUV/USD outright forwards (limited liquidity, primarily offered by ANZ and Bred for corporate hedging)
USD/VUV non-deliverable forwards (available via off-shore counterparties referencing an agreed RBV reference rate, subject to bank valuation policy)
Cross-currency swaps (USD/VUV and AUD/VUV) for institutional shareholders with bilateral ISDA documentation
FX swaps and rollovers between VUV, AUD, USD, and EUR for treasury cash-flow management

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return and Annual Maintenance Fee Filing under the International Companies Act (Cap 222)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 6 calendar months after the anniversary date of incorporation of the International Company
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing attracts incremental late penalty fees (approximately USD 50 per month); continued default triggers administrative strike-off and dissolution of the International Company. Reinstatement requires payment of all arrears, late fees, and VFSC approval for restoration.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No compulsory statutory audit for a standard Vanuatu International Company engaged in software and fintech data services. Mandatory audit applies only to VFSC-regulated licensees (banking, insurance, securities, or fiduciary services providers); a plain ISIC 6201 financial portfolio tracking application does not hold a statutory license and is exempt from the audit requirement.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS is the generally accepted accounting framework for financial statements prepared voluntarily; the Vanuatu International Companies Act requires maintenance of accounting records sufficient to accurately reflect transactions and financial position, but does not mandate filing of financial statements for ordinary international companies.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Vanuatu law does not impose an annual UBO confirmation filing for standard International Companies. On each share transfer, the board of directors must approve the transfer, the Register of Members must be updated without undue delay, and updated beneficial ownership records must be maintained at the registered office. The register is a private corporate record but must be produced for lawful inspection by VFSC, tax authorities, or authorized agencies upon formal request.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not applicable for exempt International Company; voluntary IFRS audit typically USD 3,500 - 7,500

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% (Vanuatu levies no corporate income tax; International Companies are statutorily tax-exempt)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Permanent statutory exemption under the International Companies Act (Cap 222), s.82: no income tax, no capital gains tax, no withholding tax, no estate or gift tax on profits, dividends, interest, royalties, or asset disposals; the only annual fiscal charge is the VFSC annual licence fee; foreign-source fintech subscription revenue is outside the scope of Vanuatu taxation

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No Vanuatu corporate income tax return exists. Mandatory annual compliance for an International Company is the VFSC Annual Declaration / Annual Return submitted through the registered agent portal of the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC eRegistry). An IC that makes taxable supplies to Vanuatu-resident customers must separately register under the Value Added Tax Act (Cap 83) and file the monthly VAT return via the Vanuatu Revenue and Customs portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual (VFSC Annual Declaration and licence fee); monthly for VAT registrants
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: VFSC Annual Declaration and licence fee: within three months after each incorporation anniversary. VAT return: on or before the 20th day of the month following the end of each VAT period.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal name and registration number of the International Company as recorded in the Companies Register.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Name must match the Certificate of Incorporation exactly; foreign-language brand names must be transliterated into Latin script.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: VFSC Annual Declaration - Registered Agent Address
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Contact details of the licenced Vanuatu registered agent and the physical registered office address.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A VFSC-licenced registered agent in Port Vila is mandatory; a PO Box alone is unacceptable as registered office.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: VFSC Annual Declaration - Directors and Beneficial Owner Particulars
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full names, residential addresses, nationality, and identification details of all directors, the secretary, and the ultimate beneficial owner.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors must provide foreign residential addresses and passport copies; a Vanuatu-resident secretary is required if no director resides in Vanuatu.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: VFSC Annual Declaration - Nature of Business / ESR Status
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Statement of principal business activity and confirmation of whether the company conducts an ESR-relevant activity.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: An IC operating a cloud-based personal wealth analytics platform must confirm whether it holds exploitable IP; IP holding activity triggers the ESR filing obligation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: VAT Return - Output Tax and Input Tax Boxes
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Value of taxable supplies made in Vanuatu, zero-rated supplies, exempt supplies, deductible input tax, and net VAT payable at 12.5%.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Subscription revenue from offshore non-resident users is outside the scope of Vanuatu VAT; sales to Vanuatu residents via Stripe or Apple IAP are taxable supplies.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late VFSC Annual Declaration: monetary penalties of VUV 5,000 to VUV 50,000, suspension of the licence, and strike-off from the register without court order. Late VAT return: penalty of VUV 50,000 plus 5% of the tax due for each month of default (capped at 50%), default assessment, and criminal fine if the default continues after written notice.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% - Vanuatu imposes no dividend withholding tax; distributions by an International Company to non-resident shareholders are legally free of any Vanuatu tax.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Vanuatu has no comprehensive double taxation agreement network, so no DTA relief or Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) protocol exists. Distributions and payments are remitted free of Vanuatu withholding tax; a foreign shareholder must instead rely on home-jurisdiction foreign tax credit, CFC, and transparency rules. Vanuatu participates in CRS exchange through the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit, so shareholder identity and account data may be transmitted to treaty-exempt home authorities.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Vanuatu statutory withholding tax on cross-border royalties and interest is 0% for non-resident recipients. No treaty-reduced rate is applicable because no DTA exists. However, if the IC is treated as carrying on an IP business under the Economic Substance Regulations Act 2020, it must maintain full economic substance in Vanuatu before royalty income can retain its exempt status.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No general transfer pricing documentation law exists because there is no corporate income tax. The mandatory documentation-triggering thresholds that do apply: (i) Economic Substance Regulations Act 2020 - ESR return required where gross income from a relevant activity exceeds the gazetted de minimis threshold (approximately VUV 30 million / USD 260,000); (ii) Country-by-Country reporting - an IC belonging to a multinational group with consolidated revenue above EUR 750 million is reportable through the Vanuatu competent authority exchange mechanism.
approved_arm_length_methodologies: No statutory Vanuatu TP methodology list; the OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines 2022 are the accepted interpretive reference for ESR remuneration and related-party pricing in Vanuatu
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Economic Substance Regulations Act 2020: an International Company carrying on a relevant activity - including financing/leasing, distribution and service centre business, pure equity holding, or intellectual property business - must demonstrate in Vanuatu: (i) board meetings and minutes held in Vanuatu; (ii) physically present employees with adequate qualifications; (iii) adequate operating expenditure incurred in Vanuatu; and (iv) core income-generating activities performed in Vanuatu. An annual ESR return must be filed with VFSC. A software-as-a-service wealth-tracking platform holding proprietary code as IP must either prove genuine Vanuatu IP substance or pivot to a low-risk agency/service characterization.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The Vanuatu IC is a nominee-only vehicle with no physical office, no employees, no local board meetings, and no Vanuatu expenditure, yet it invoices global portfolio-tracking subscription revenue and holds the software IP in its name.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Penalties under the Economic Substance Regulations Act 2020 up to VUV 15,000,000; court-ordered strike-off from the company register; referral to the Public Prosecutor for criminal enforcement; and publication of the entity on a non-compliant list shared with the OECD Forum on Harmful Tax Practices.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are exposed to civil restitution orders, director disqualification by the Vanuatu Supreme Court, personal fines, and travel bans of up to 25 years where the court finds knowing participation in a sham substance arrangement.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The beneficial owner deliberately omits the Vanuatu IC bank account, subscription revenue, and financial portfolio tracking data from home-country tax returns, relying on the IC's exemption and confidentiality while CRS data is nevertheless exchanged.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Home-jurisdiction liability: accuracy penalties up to 150% of the evaded tax, interest, anti-money-laundering fines, and criminal prosecution. In Vanuatu, making false statements to the Financial Intelligence Unit is an offence under the Penal Code (Cap 135) punishable by fine or imprisonment.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Personal prosecution in the shareholder's home country for tax fraud; CFC-attribution of the IC's income to the individual; Vanuatu directors may face extradition under the Mutual Assistance in Criminal Matters legislation and personal asset freeze orders.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The IC conducts third-party portfolio management, fund administration, or payment aggregation through Stripe/Apple IAP without a VFSC Investment Dealer licence under the Dealers in Securities Act (Cap 69), or functions as a shadow financial institution.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Conviction for unlicensed securities dealing or possession of client funds: fines up to VUV 50,000,000, confiscation of proceeds, mandatory revocation of the company registration, and inclusion in FATF grey-list risk communications.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly control the unlicensed activity face criminal liability for money laundering under the Penal Code with imprisonment up to 20 years, personal asset confiscation, and a prohibition on acting as a director of any VFSC-regulated entity.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The 'International Company' sells the fintech tracking subscription to Vanuatu-resident consumers or on-island users while failing to register under the Value Added Tax Act (Cap 83), failing to charge 12.5% VAT, and filing no VAT returns.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: VAT default penalty of 50% of the tax concerned; default assessment for up to 36 months; penalty of VUV 50,000 plus daily penalty up to VUV 10,000; criminal prosecution and fine if non-compliance continues after notice.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are personally liable for the unpaid VAT and penalties under the VAT Act enforcement provisions; the Commissioner of Taxes may issue a travel restriction order against directors until the VAT debt is settled.
